purpose: chamber volume floor load and panel count check
code_or_query:
from pint import UnitRegistry
Q_=UnitRegistry().Quantity
internal_L=2.4; internal_W=2.0; internal_H=2.2
V=internal_L*internal_W*internal_H
floor_area=internal_L*internal_W
mass=1000.0
produce_density_bulk=350.0 # kg/m3 crates with air gaps
produce_vol=mass/produce_density_bulk
pressure_kPa=mass*9.81/floor_area/1000
crate_L=0.6; crate_W=0.4; crate_H=0.22
crates_needed=int(mass/20)+2  # ~20kg per crate
footprints_per_layer=int((2.0//0.6)*2)  # racks both sides
print(f"V={V:.2f} m3 produce_vol={produce_vol:.2f} m3 fill={produce_vol/V*100:.1f}% pressure={pressure_kPa:.2f} kPa crates~{crates_needed} footprints/layer~{footprints_per_layer}")
